sentences.text: Pre-operative multi-sequence MRI: axial T1, contrast-enhanced T1 (T1ce), T2 and FLAIR, co-registered, skull-stripped and resampled to 1 mm isotropic (BraTS preparation).
The tumour contains a necrotic / non-enhancing core (confidence 0.61). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The whole-tumour mass is predominantly right-sided (confidence 0.97).
An enhancing tumour component is present (confidence 0.98).
Whole-tumour burden is assessed as large (volume tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.64). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The enhancing fraction of the whole tumour is low (ET/WT tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.50). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
Acquisition quality (cjv, efc, snr, sharpness, inu, contrast, entropy) is mildly outside the training cohort range (mean |z| = 0.80); interpret borderline findings with corresponding caution.
Automated release: case confidence 0.61 meets the calibrated gate threshold 0.55.
Key findings: ncr_present present (p=0.61); laterality right (p=0.97).
